rule: Exclude an exact served model release from the primary APE-120 wave when an author-reported or independently reported APE turn-1 result for that exact release is already in the repository evidence registry. Adjacent releases and distinct service tiers remain eligible.

exclusions.reported_protocol: APE turn 1, supporting role, maximum reasoning
exclusions.reason: An exact-release APE result is already available from secondary research; rerunning it would spend scarce primary-research budget without adding a new release point.

non_exclusions: Adjacent checkpoints in the GPT-5, Claude, and GLM families remain eligible because they add longitudinal release points.
Secondary results from MASK, DisElect, InfoOpsBench, or Anthropic agentic-influence evaluations do not exclude a model from APE because they measure different constructs.
The prior six-topic project APE construction canary is not a 120-topic benchmark result and does not exclude either DeepSeek V4 Flash checkpoint.
